setupWizard.resume: Your answers are stored on this server, so you can stop and resume with the same link.
setupWizard.generic: The answer was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.

reasons.restricted_place: A restricted place is never offered, hosted or served. Choose another country, region or place.
reasons.install_check_failed: A blocking install check failed, so setup cannot continue.
reasons.jurisdiction_unknown: This country or region is not known to the engine.
reasons.jurisdiction_not_selectable: This country or region cannot be chosen.
reasons.pack_unknown: This country has no country pack yet. Start from the generic profile.
reasons.time_zone_unknown: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name such as America/Chicago.
reasons.modes_violation: These modes contradict a draft hub.
reasons.node_fixed: The node identity is fixed once the founding administrator is set up.
reasons.first_admin_only: Only the founding administrator can continue this setup. Sign in with that account.
reasons.admin_account_mismatch: Sign in with the account created in this setup.
reasons.first_admin_bound: The founding administrator is already set up.
reasons.second_factor_required: Turn on two-step verification with an authenticator app first; the ten recovery codes are shown once.
reasons.second_factor_unavailable: Passkeys are not available yet. Use an authenticator app.
reasons.jurisdiction_gate_unconfigured: Configure the jurisdiction gate on the server (TRUSTWORK_JURISDICTION_GATE) before finishing.
reasons.jurisdiction_gate_mismatch: The server runs a different jurisdiction gate from the one stated in the operator step.
reasons.attestation_invalid: The deployment-location attestation is not valid.
reasons.attestation_required: Setup finishes only with a valid deployment-location attestation.
reasons.payload_invalid: An answer does not fit the hub configuration. Review the steps.
reasons.elevation: Confirm with your password and the code from your authenticator app.
reasons.access.not_found: This setup link is no longer valid. Ask the server for a new one.
reasons.auth.invalid_credentials: The password or the code is not correct.
reasons.auth.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
reasons.validation.schema: Check the fields and try again.
reasons.validation.unknown_field: Check the fields and try again.
reasons.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.

checkReasons.https_required: The public address must use HTTPS (or localhost for a trial).
checkReasons.localhost_trial: A localhost address is fine for a trial, never for a public hub.
checkReasons.runtime_role_bypasses_rls: The runtime database role can bypass row-level security.
checkReasons.role_unknown: The runtime database role could not be identified.
checkReasons.unreachable: The database could not be reached.
checkReasons.not_configured: No object storage is configured yet; evidence files cannot be stored.
checkReasons.probe_failed: Writing, reading or deleting a test object failed.
checkReasons.no_heartbeat_source: The worker does not report a heartbeat yet, so this cannot be confirmed.
checkReasons.no_recent_heartbeat: No worker heartbeat was seen in the last minute.
checkReasons.clock_skew: The server clock differs from your browser's by more than 30 seconds.
checkReasons.development_key: The public development key is in use; set a real secret key before going public.

hub.countryHelp: Required: every hub belongs to a country. Restricted places are never offered.
hub.territoriesHelp: Country, region and place codes separated by commas, for example US, US-CA, US-CA:san-diego.
hub.slugHelp: Optional, for example us-san-diego; derived from the territory when empty.
hub.nameHelp: Used for every hub language for now; give each language its own spelling in the console.
hub.languagesHelp: Engine language tags, the default first, for example en, es.

operator.attestationHelp: Where the operator's legal entity and the hosting are, and which jurisdiction gate the server runs. The founding administrator attests this statement when finishing; the engine never detects where the server is.
operator.regionHelp: An ISO 3166-2 code such as US-DE; required where the restricted list distinguishes regions.

gateModes.ranges_file: Address ranges file on this server
gateModes.edge_header: Country header from the edge network
gateModes.upstream_gate: Gate run by the hosting platform

screening.title: Operator screening
screening.clear: No match on the engine's baseline lists.
screening.possible_match: Possible match: compliance staff review it; the operator cannot close the review.
screening.not_screened: Not screened: no baseline list is loaded yet.
screening.insufficient_name: The name is too short to screen.

admin.accountHelp: The founding administrator's own account. A verification link goes to this address; on a node without live e-mail the worker writes it to its log.
admin.accountSent: If the address can receive mail, a verification link is on its way. Open it, then sign in with the new account and come back to this link.
admin.factorHelp: Set up an authenticator app in your security settings. Ten single-use recovery codes are shown once; store them before continuing.
admin.confirmHelp: You receive the node operator role for this node. With one staff member the hub runs in reduced separation of duties until a second staff member joins.
admin.signedOut: Sign in with the account created in this setup to continue.
admin.factorMissing: Two-step verification is not on for this account yet.
admin.notYou: This setup belongs to another founding administrator. Sign in with that account.

residency.personalDataCountry: Where personal data is stored and processed

states.missing: Not attested yet: attested with your elevated session when you finish.
states.expired: Expired: attested again when you finish.
states.contradicted: Contradicted by the current configuration: attested again when you finish.
states.restricted: Names a place that is restricted now.

review.confirmHelp: Finishing creates the hub as a draft, records its configuration and invalidates this link. Confirm with your password and the code from your authenticator app.
review.finished: Setup finished. The hub is a draft; continue in the console.
